clips.title: The story
paras: At Shael'dryn's direction, Raene's Cleansing now leads you to a mountain shrine with the rebuilt Rod of Dartol. The basin there holds the magic needed to restore its enchantment.

Shael'dryn sends you from her moonwell into Ashenvale's wild southeastern slopes. The ancient shrines of Ashenvale often stood high among mountain crags, far from roads and hidden beneath dense forest canopies. You must cross unmarked ground along the rock faces and climb winding trails known mostly to Sentinels and woodland hermits.

A stone basin waits in a quiet forest alcove. Though dormant, the shrine holds protective magic placed there by night elves long ago. Rest the rebuilt Rod of Dartol in the basin, and the shrine's sleeping power awakens. Its magic flows into the rod, restoring its enchantment so it can cleanse the land.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the completed rod, friend. Reconstructing it was simple... It's finding the shrine that has the power to recharge it that will be the hard part.
With some focus and effort it shouldn't be too hard for someone like you, who's already accomplished so much.
Head southeast of here--there are very few paths, so be careful--and keep your eyes to the north. The shrine is hidden within the mountains that surround this glade.
Once there, place the rod within the shrine... The rest is magic. Hehe.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You can sense a subtle yet powerful force within the shrine and surrounding trees.
You begin placing the rod within the shrine and a soft thrumming noise emits from around you as the shrine begins to glow...

clips.title: Completion
paras: After the glow dies, you can see the re-enchanted rod within the shrine's basin.
